Hi Marissa,

I downloaded the Redwood benchmark report last week and found the latency/cost profiles for the candidate models really helpful. We’re evaluating inference platforms for a production pilot and I’d like to schedule a short demo next week to see Redwood in action (particularly routing/fallback and cost controls).

Quick context:
- Company: Acme Analytics (series B, ~65 engs)
- Use case: customer-facing summarization and search (real-time, 200–600 RPS peak)
- Priority: predictable latency and lower token costs

I’m generally available Tue-Thu afternoons (ET). Can you share 30 minutes that works on your side? Also happy to invite our infra lead if that’s useful.

Thanks,
